criteria.criterion: Parallel tracker synchronization calls against one Git common directory complete without exposing or silently discarding the stale-reference comparison failure.
An attested snapshot fetch racing with another ref-updating fetch against the same Git common directory completes through bounded recovery or returns one actionable exhausted-recovery error.
Coordination identity follows symlinks and linked worktrees to the canonical Git common directory.
Network fetches do not hold the ticket write lock, and a blocked remote does not block local ticket writes.
The explicit tickets destination refspec remains in place and narrow-clone synchronization tests remain green.
Deterministic tests use local repositories, observe the failure before the fix, and exercise parallel and serialized controls at both affected entry points.
Current concurrency documentation names the ref-fetch coordination and recovery policy.
